note: #88 (b), Tester 2026-10-20: California agency open data with geocoded collisions linkable to CCRS by report number. Measured on public data only; nothing enters the app (user decision + terms check first, as #126 for TIMS). Link rates: CCRS 2024 crashes of that agency whose Report Number matches a record with coordinates.

sources.dataset: City of San Jose, Crash Locations Last Five Years (GIS layer 553)
sources.coords: LATITUDE/LONGITUDE (city geocode; REPORTEDLOCATIONFOUND Yes/No; often intersection-level)
sources.terms: GIS disclaimer: provided 'as is', use at your own risk; no licence text found. Confirm terms before product use.
sources.notes: City data has 5,594 crashes in 2024 vs 2,453 in CCRS for SJPD (CCRS holds 44%). SJPD's CCRS GPS is degrees-minutes-seconds (bug #143): this source confirmed it.

sources.dataset: City of Pasadena, Traffic Collisions (owner CityOfPasadenaCAGIS)
sources.terms: Licence marked 'custom' with no text published; updated annually. Confirm terms before product use.
sources.notes: Pasadena PD writes GPS on 0.4% of CCRS reports, so this is nearly its only coordinate source.

sources.dataset: DataSF, Traffic Crashes Resulting in Injury
sources.terms: DataSF open data (public domain dedication per DataSF terms); confirm.
sources.notes: Injury crashes only. Used as truth in PR #16.

sources.dataset: LA City, Traffic Collision Data from 2010 to Present
sources.link: DR number = CCRS Report Number without dashes (PR #16)
sources.coords: location_1 (snapped to intersections, see pain point 6)
sources.terms: City of LA open data terms; confirm.
sources.notes: No longer updated after LAPD's records-system change; a replacement dataset is expected.

sources.dataset: City of San Diego, Traffic collisions (basic reports)
sources.coords: none: block-level address + police beat only
sources.terms: ODC Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL)
sources.notes: Linkable but not geocoded: the block address could help placement; not measured.

sources.dataset: County of Los Angeles, All Collisions 2017 to 2021
sources.link: REPORT_NO + NCIC = CCRS Report Number + NCIC Code
sources.notes: Mostly CHP crashes that already have GPS; adds almost nothing for unplaced crashes. Ends 2021.
